findings.excerpt: IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY’S AGGREGATE LIABILITY ... EXCEED THE AMOUNTS PAID BY CUSTOMER TO VENDOR IN THE THREE (3) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM.
findings.rationale: Cap of only 3 months of fees is below the preferred 12-month standard. High risk of insufficient recovery.
Unlimited indemnification for confidentiality and IP claims. Deviates from preferred mutual + capped position.

findings.excerpt: This obligation shall survive for a period of two (2) years after termination.
findings.rationale: 2-year survival is acceptable but below preferred 3–5 years.

findings.excerpt: There is no right of termination for convenience.
findings.rationale: Missing termination for convenience. Acceptable only for short-term or highly customized agreements.
